BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Trickster Dragon Mimyugon!!
Are you guys all right?!
We're good!\nJust focus on steering the rock mass, Sir!
Urgh!!
Oh, what is it?!
Are you okay?!
Oh, it's you Zianga! But why...\nOh well, thank god you're here!!
Phew, somehow we made it in time...
Ufufufu...
Fufufu...This is good.\nI bet crushing this place would earn us more\nrewards than causing a commotion in Draco Town!!
Oh my gosh!!\nWhat are you doing?!
Oh gosh!!\nWhat the hey is this?!
You bastard! So you're actually the dragon's\npawn!!
The original plan was to get you to take us to\nDraco Town, then we'll unleash Master Mimyugon to\nannihilate the weredragons all at once, but now
I think it'd be faster to just destroy this place\nand crash the whole Movere forest. I'm sure we'll\nget more rewards. Now Master Mimyugon, run wild!!
You idiot! If this rock mass collapses, I'll lose\neverything...
Well whatever, I'll kill everyone in here.\nAfter that make sure you take me to Draco Town!
O-okay.
You betrayed us even though you're a weredragon\ntoo. You're a disgrace!!
If you move, he dies!
Oops...
Ugh...you coward!
Get rid of this guy if you wanna show me your\nloyalty!
No, don't! If you do it, you'll never be able to\ngo back to the weredragon world!!
I heard you're the leader's grandson. You won't\nunderstand the pain and hardships we stray\nweredragons went through...I'm gonna kill you!!
Ugh?!
Ughhhh!\nD-darn you! I'm not gonna go easy on you!!
Whoa?! You bastard!!
Master Mimyugon!\nAt least let's get rid of this guy!\nCome on, master, do it!!
Mubandi! Enough, stop it now!!
Mubandiiii, nooooooo!!
You got Silver Nugget...
...In the old days, there was a faction of\nweredragons who hate the rules set by the leader,\nso they set out in search of a new land...
But the life in the new land was harsh...While\nbeing forced to live a hard life there, they grew\nto resent those on the leader's side...
The dragon took advantage of that situation and\nmade many weredragons his pawns...Mubandi too was\nblinded by the rewards he offered...
Was that why you two pretended to be a married\ncouple so that you could take that dragon to\nDraco Town and let him go berserk there?
But why do the dragons want to attack the\nweredragons?
...I don't know for sure, but one thing that seems\ncertain is they loathe the weredragons so much...
I know it sounds like an excuse, but I was\nthreatened. I'm very sorry for the trouble...I'll\nreturn to the village I came from...Goodbye...
I'm sorry! You were right, I shouldn't have\ntrusted them.\nI'm really sorry!!
...You think they would not fool you just because\nthey're your kind. That kind of mindset is\nclouding your judgment. You'd better be careful.
You've experienced something like that too before?
Oh, you guys have been very helpful...
The thing is my mind is already occupied with the\noutput power of the propulsion system that has\nbecome unstable, I can't stop worrying about it...
What do you mean?
Actually, it's become unstable since a while ago\nand it's been causing a disruption to the Movere\nforest and rock mass navigation.
I checked it and nothing was wrong, but the power\ntransmitted from the vital point is fluctuating\nviolently. Something might have happened there.
That would be bad...
We should go to the vital point of the weredragons\nimmediately.\nLet's hurry!
Uncle Boontam! How do we get to the vital point of\nthe weredragons?!
What do you mean how...? As you can see it's\nfloating up there, so you just go up there...
Oh yeah, head north from Nebula Plain.\nYou should be able to get there without getting\nlost.
Thanks! Let's go!!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back for now!
